in_latin.long_meaning: The name Ylva, of Norse mythology, might be connected to the Germanic goddess of love and fertility, derived from Old Norse words ylfr and væ. While not directly associated with Christianity, Ylva's mystical, otherworldly connotations could be seen as resonating with Christian mysticism and the feminine divine, as represented in the Virgin Mary or the Holy Spirit.
